question: In which year was the 11th Fundamental Duty added in the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is__** 2002. **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fundamental Duties** were added to the **Constitution of India** through the **42nd Amendment Act, 1976.**
 
• The **11th** Fundamental Duty was added to the Indian Constitution in **2002.**
 
• The 11th Fundamental Duty of Indian citizens is to provide educational opportunities to children between the ages of 6 and 14, and to ensure that parents provide these opportunities to their children. 
 
• The inclusion of Fundamental Duties was inspired by the** Constitution of the former USSR **and aims to promote a sense of patriotism and civic responsibility among citizens. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fundamental Duties** were recommended by the** Swaran Singh Committee** in** 1976,** and their importance became apparent during the** internal emergency of 1975–1977.**
 
• **Ten **Fundamental Duties were added to the Indian Constitution by the **42nd Amendment Act of 1976.**
 
• Later, the** 11th** Fundamental Duty was added to the list by the** 86th Amendment Act of 2002.**
 
• In **Article 51A of Part IV **A of the Indian Constitution, the Fundamental Duties are addressed.
 
• Indian Fundamental Duties include maintaining** public property, honoring our flag, listening to the national song **with reverence, and abiding by the Indian Constitution.
